subject: GoodHealth kickoff — pick a time & preflight checklist
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@goodhealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 10 Apr 2029 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: GoodHealth onboarding — proposed slots & quick preflight

Hi Alice / GoodHealth team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood — excited to get you onboarded. To lock the kickoff session we'll need a 60–75 minute slot with the following goals: introductions, goals & scope alignment, tech preflight (network, SSO, dataflows), and next steps + action owners.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Apr 16, 11:00–12:15
- Wed Apr 17, 09:00–10:15
- Thu Apr 18, 13:00–14:15

Suggested internal attendees from our side: Irene (onboarding lead), Marissa (implementation PM), Ben (AM). Please confirm who from GoodHealth should join (we recommend Product owner + IT admin + Security).

Preflight asks (short):
- Provide a technical contact who can create a temporary test account and enable SSO for redwood@your-domain (or we can use a managed test account)
- Confirm whether domains/proxy restrict outbound traffic to Zoom or external APIs
- Share any network allowlist or proxy IPs if relevant

I've attached the draft SOW for reference and will drop a kickoff agenda ICS once we lock timing.

Attachments: GoodHealth_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW, 2 pages)

Next steps: please reply with preferred slot + attendee list and the tech contact. If none of the windows work, propose two alternatives and we'll adjust.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@goodhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: GoodHealth onboarding — proposed slots & quick preflight

Hi Ben — thanks for the note. Wed Apr 17, 09:00–10:15 PST works best for our team. Attendees:
- Alice Gomez (Product lead)
- Mike Torres (IT Admin)
- Priya Das (Security) — will loop in if necessary; she’s currently OOO until Friday but should be able to join remotely if needed.

Tech contact: Mike Torres (mike.torres@goodhealth.com). He can provision a test service account and confirm SSO details beforehand.

One quick Q on data retention: we typically require logs to be retained 13 months for audit. Can you confirm Redwood’s default retention window and whether we can extend it for our account?

Also adding: please include any pre-kickoff checklist so Mike can validate firewall/proxy rules before the meeting.

Thanks,

Alice
Product Manager | GoodHealth Inc.
alice.gomez@goodhealth.com | +1 206-555-0987

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@goodhealth.com>, Mike Torres <mike.torres@goodhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Apr 2029 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: GoodHealth onboarding — proposed slots & quick preflight

Thanks Alice — Wed Apr 17 at 09:00 PST is locked on our side. Calendar invite (Zoom + agenda) will follow; provisional link below.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9223344556 (passcode: GHkickoff)
Draft agenda (60–75 min):
- 09:00–09:10 Introductions & success metrics (Alice, Ben, Irene)
- 09:10–09:25 Scope & rollout milestones (Marissa)
- 09:25–09:45 Technical preflight (Mike + our infra lead): network rules, SSO, API access, test account validation
- 09:45–09:55 Roles & action owners / immediate next steps
- 09:55–10:00 Q&A and wrap

Pre-kickoff checklist for Mike (short):
- Create a temporary test user/service account and share credentials via our secure form (we'll send a link)
- Confirm whether outbound connections to zoom.us and *.redwood.ai are allowed or if your proxy requires allowlisting specific IPs
- If using SSO, share IdP metadata or a test SAML assertion; otherwise we can use a short-lived managed account
- Let us know if retention needs differ from our default (we retain logs 12 months by default; we can discuss an enterprise retention add-on)

Attachments: kickoff-agenda.ics (calendar item)

Marissa — can you add the Milestones doc to the Drive folder and drop the preflight form link? I'll follow up with an invite once the ICS is uploaded.

Thanks all — looking forward to it.

Irene Choi
Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0145

From: Mike Torres <mike.torres@goodhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@goodhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Apr 2029 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: GoodHealth onboarding — proposed slots & quick preflight

Irene / Ben / team — confirmed for 09:00 PST. I’ll bring our IT lead (Sanjay Patel) as an extra backup for the technical preflight; he’s joining remotely. We’ve provisioned a test service account (details sent via the secure form) and verified outbound to zoom.us and *.redwood.ai is allowed.

Regarding retention: Good to know 12 months is default. For our procurement notes, we may request 13 months as part of the contract — Alice will keep that on the procurement thread. Please flag any changes to logging policies that would affect audit scope.

See you shortly.

— Mike
Mike Torres
IT Administrator | GoodHealth Inc.
mike.torres@goodhealth.com | +1 206-555-0179
